about: Manual post-run audit of every fact promoted by the frozen spec-extractor-4 on the 28-page held-out set (results-firstrun-spec-extractor-4.json). Fact indices refer to the evaluator's audit file, which is kept outside the repository because it holds third-party declaration values. Adjudicated after the first run; nothing here was used to change the first-run numbers.
criteria: A fact is correct when (1) its label/value pairing is faithful to the page, (2) it is a property of a product (not a retailer, store, document link or availability row), (3) it is attributed to the right product or variant under a usable product identity, and (4) its normalized value preserves the raw meaning (qualifiers, multipliers). Values faithfully copied from a page that are themselves inconsistent (e.g. a '1.8' under 'Capacity (ml)') count as correct declarations.

configuration_or_size_row_used_as_produc.note: Size-chart rows (US size -> EU/UK/CM) and seat-height configurations became named products.

comparison_table_product_name_polluted.note: Values sit on the right model, but product names include link text ('View details →', HTML entity left encoded) or 'This model' instead of resolving to the page product.

non_product_row.note: Document DOWNLOAD links, size-conversion rows on the main product, delivery time, retailer contact details, store stock rows and size availability.

group_heading_concatenated_with_row.note: A section heading cell plus its first row became a duplicate property ('Software = Eye-CareU Yes').

normalization_lost_meaning.note: '1 x 36 V', '1 x 250 W', '2Wx2' parsed as dimensions; 'under 100mm' became exactly 100 mm.

placeholder_price_zero.note: Structured data declares price 0; a zero price is a placeholder, not an offer.

notes: Six pages (x_benq2780, x_benqbl, x_sharpmg, x_sharpqs, x_havit892, x_99bikes100) share templates with sibling pages, so errors are correlated; by distinct template the dominant failure classes are: size/configuration tables as products (2 sites), comparison-table naming (1 site), non-product rows (5 sites).

Abstention violations (x_altitude vestibule, x_wcsl model number/UPC/EAN) are faithful strings that carry two variants' values on the main product; they are counted by the evaluator, not as precision errors here.
